estimand: Probability each of all 32 franchises qualifies for playoffs in zero-intervention simulated actual-draft baseline
labels: Membership in complete recorded season's postseason games, including teams with first-round byes; never reconstruct labels using simulated standings
comparator: Constant season-specific playoff-slot prevalence, 12/32 in 2018-2019 and 14/32 thereafter
metrics: aggregate Brier MC standard error using independent origin-seed blocks
exclusions: No season after 2025 or incomplete observed season; do not replace absent outcomes with zero
decision: Descriptive audit only; no tuning, adoption or gameplay changes based on these exposed outcomes
dependence: Origins' horizons overlap actual team-seasons; aggregate row count is not independent sample size; seed Monte Carlo uncertainty is not generalization uncertainty
